amendments.reason: The semantic judgment schema permits supporting_source_ids for all claim types, but experiment claims are structurally forbidden from linking literature. Two model responses populated this irrelevant auxiliary field and were rejected despite otherwise usable judgments.
amendments.behavior_change: For experiment claims only, deterministically replace supporting_source_ids with an empty list before linked-source validation. Verdict, rationale, claim text, evidence, metrics, and gate decisions are unchanged.

amendments.reason: The shared finalizer copied the exact top-level run-record improvement field into metric_values. The structural checker correctly limits metric_values to aggregate_metrics keys, causing a mechanical false positive even though the same linked record directly supports the improvement value in claim text.
amendments.behavior_change: When and only when metric_values.improvement exactly equals the linked run record improvement field and aggregate_metrics has no improvement metric, remove that key from metric_values. Claim text, linked record, metric score, verdict, and all model outputs remain unchanged; unknown extra metrics still fail closed.
